query: Which method can be used for oxidation resistance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Ultrafine-grained samples of AlCoCrFeNi HEA show enhanced oxidation resistance due to the formation of a dense chromia layer and internal Al-rich oxide layered structure.
generation.material_initial_state: As-cast AlCoCrFeNi HEA with BCC/B2 phases and 98 um grain size
generation.intervention: Stationary Friction Processing (SFP) with WC-cylindrical tool
generation.conditions: 400-1800 rpm, 5 rpm/min, 100 h at 850-1050°C in laboratory air
generation.structural_mediator: Grain size refinement to 1 um and 0.43 um
generation.mechanism: Increased grain boundaries favoring outward flux of elements to form a dense chromia layer followed by internal Al-rich oxide layered structure
generation.baseline: As-cast HEA with BCC/B2 phases and 98 um grain size
generation.boundary: Applicability to other alloys or processing methods not established
generation.uncertainty: Generalizability to other alloys or processing methods not established
generation.falsification_experiment: Oxidation kinetics measurement and microstructure analysis of ultrafine-grained AlCoCrFeNi HEA samples prepared by different processing methods
